s: The acidity of carboxylic acid is directly proportional to the acid dissociation constant. But it is inversely proportional to the pKₐ value because the pKₐ is equal to the −logKₐ. So, the order of acidity of given acids depends upon the −M,−I effect. It is directly proportional to the −M,−I effect. The acetic acid is least acidic. So, it has the pKₐ value of 4.76. After that acidity of benzoic acid. So, it has the pKₐ value of 4.19. After that acidity of p−nitrobenzoic acid. So, it has the pKₐ value of 3.41. The compound F₃CCOOH is most acidic. So, it has the pKₐ value of 0.23.
p: Preparation and Properties of Carboxylic Acids
